title: Member Payment of Rider Premium Owed, Taken on the Call
content:
A member who owes rider premium on one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders may pay money of their own toward it during the call, and the money is posted to that rider's premium account against the coverage month named.

## The condition the figure waits on

The money a member is asked for is fixed only after every rider premium charge raised for a coverage month beginning before the day the rider took effect carries a credit against it.

## Taking the payment

The payment is taken with `pay_rider_premium_by_telephone_9597e982`. The tool belongs to the member: the representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to pay money of their own.

### Parameters

- `osb_rider_id` — Id class. The reference number of the member's optional supplemental benefit rider whose premium account the money is being paid into, read from the member's rider records.
- `osb_rider_premium_entry_id` — Id class. The reference number of the rider premium charge entry the money is applied against, read from the member's rider premium account entries. The coverage month of that charge is the coverage month the money is booked to.
- `settlement_amount` — Fixed-format class. The money the member is paying, in USD to 2 decimal places, as a plain positive number with no currency sign. It is stored rounded to 2 decimal places.
- `balance_effect` — Enum class. What this posting does to the rider premium the member owes, exactly one of: `not_applicable`, carried by entries that move nothing against that balance and never right on money actually received; `partial_payment`, where rider premium is still owing with this money posted; `settles_balance`, where this money clears the rider premium owed and nothing is left owing; `overpayment`, where this money comes to more than the rider premium owed and the excess stands to the member's credit.
- `remittance_reference` — Verbatim class. The payment reference printed on the rider premium bill the member is paying against, as the member reads it out, copied character for character with its original wording, digits and punctuation and with nothing translated, normalised, summarised, added or dropped.

### What the posting does

The money is recorded as received by telephone payment, and the rider premium the member still owes is restated: it falls by the money paid where the posting is stated to leave part of it standing, and falls to nothing where the posting is stated to clear it, in which case the rider stands in force again and pays for services from today. The plan gives the member a payment reference for the posting.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the payment reference the plan has given the posting, the money received in USD, the coverage month it was applied to, the rider premium the member is left owing in USD, and what the posting did to that balance. The sentence being returned at all is what indicates the money has been taken and posted.

## Basis Q&A

**Which coverage month is the money booked to?** The coverage month of the rider premium charge entry the money is applied against.

**Which of the four balance effects is never right on money actually received?** `not_applicable`, which is carried by entries that move nothing against the balance.

**What is recorded as the channel?** The money is recorded as received by telephone payment.
